commands.label: def Bosonize.A01.integerCharacter
commands.text: def integerCharacter (ζ : K) (k x : ℤ) : K := ζ ^ (k * x)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A01.residueCharacter
commands.text:
def residueCharacter (L : ℕ) (ζ : K) (k x : Ch01.Lattice L) : K :=
  integerCharacter ζ (k.val : ℤ) (x.val : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A01.bandCharacter
commands.text:
def bandCharacter (L : ℕ) (ζ : K) (k : Ch01.Band L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : K :=
  integerCharacter ζ k.val (x.val : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.A01.bandEquiv
commands.text:
noncomputable def bandEquiv (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : Ch01.Band L ≃ Ch01.Lattice L :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (Ch01.bandProjection L)
    (Ch01.band_projection_bijective L (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne L)))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A01.canonicalRoot
commands.text:
noncomputable def canonicalRoot (L : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I / (L : ℂ))

commands.label: def Bosonize.A01.normalization
commands.text: noncomputable def normalization (L : ℕ) : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (L : ℝ))⁻¹

Bosonize.A01.band_character_add.text: lemma band_character_add (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k p : Ch01.Band L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : bandCharacter L ζ (Ch01.bandAdd L (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne L)) k p) x = bandCharacter L ζ k x * bandCharacter L ζ p x

Bosonize.A01.band_character_neg.text: lemma band_character_neg (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : bandCharacter L ζ (Ch01.bandNeg L (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne L)) k) x = integerCharacter ζ (-k.val) (x.val : ℤ)

Bosonize.A01.band_character_projection.text: lemma band_character_projection (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : bandCharacter L ζ k x = residueCharacter L ζ (Ch01.bandProjection L k) x

Bosonize.A01.band_character_sub.text: lemma band_character_sub (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k p : Ch01.Band L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : bandCharacter L ζ (Ch01.bandAdd L (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne L)) k (Ch01.bandNeg L (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne L)) p)) x = integerCharacter ζ (k.val - p.val) (x.val : ℤ)

Bosonize.A01.canonical_character_std.text: lemma canonical_character_std (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (k x : Ch01.Lattice L) : residueCharacter L (canonicalRoot L) k x = ZMod.stdAddChar (k * x)

Bosonize.A01.canonical_root_primitive.text: lemma canonical_root_primitive (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : IsPrimitiveRoot (canonicalRoot L) L

Bosonize.A01.character_ne_zero.text: lemma character_ne_zero (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k x : ℤ) : integerCharacter ζ k x ≠ 0

Bosonize.A01.character_nontrivial.text: lemma character_nontrivial (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Lattice L) (hk : k ≠ 0) : ∃ x : Ch01.Lattice L, residueCharacter L ζ k x ≠ 1

Bosonize.A01.character_orthogonality.text: lemma character_orthogonality (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k p : Ch01.Band L) : (∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, integerCharacter ζ (k.val - p.val) (x.val : ℤ)) = if k = p then (L : K) else 0

Bosonize.A01.character_representative_in.text: lemma character_representative_independent (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k x s t : ℤ) : integerCharacter ζ (k + s * (L : ℤ)) (x + t * (L : ℤ)) = integerCharacter ζ k x

Bosonize.A01.character_sum.text: lemma character_sum (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Lattice L) : (∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, residueCharacter L ζ k x) = if k = 0 then (L : K) else 0

Bosonize.A01.complex_character_conj.text: lemma complex_character_conj (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k x : ℤ) : star (integerCharacter ζ k x) = integerCharacter ζ (-k) x

Bosonize.A01.complex_character_norm.text: lemma complex_character_norm (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k x : ℤ) : ‖integerCharacter ζ k x‖ = 1

Bosonize.A01.dual_character_orthogonalit.text: lemma dual_character_orthogonality (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (x y : Ch01.Lattice L) : (∑ k : Ch01.Band L, integerCharacter ζ k.val ((x.val : ℤ) - (y.val : ℤ))) = if x = y then (L : K) else 0

Bosonize.A01.normalization_car_coefficie.text: lemma normalization_car_coefficient (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : ‖(normalization L : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * (L : ℝ) = 1

Bosonize.A01.normalization_conj.text: lemma normalization_conj (L : ℕ) : star (normalization L : ℂ) = (normalization L : ℂ)

Bosonize.A01.normalization_pos.text: lemma normalization_pos (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : 0 < normalization L

Bosonize.A01.normalization_square.text: lemma normalization_square (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (L : ℝ) * normalization L ^ 2 = 1

Bosonize.A01.normalization_square_comple.text: lemma normalization_square_complex (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (L : ℂ) * (normalization L : ℂ) ^ 2 = 1

Bosonize.A01.nyquist_character_neg.text: lemma nyquist_character_neg (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (hEven : Even L) (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) (hk : k.val = ((L / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : integerCharacter ζ (-k.val) (x.val : ℤ) = bandCharacter L ζ k x

Bosonize.A01.residue_character_add_left.text: lemma residue_character_add_left (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k p x : Ch01.Lattice L) : residueCharacter L ζ (k + p) x = residueCharacter L ζ k x * residueCharacter L ζ p x

Bosonize.A01.residue_character_add_right.text: lemma residue_character_add_right (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k x y : Ch01.Lattice L) : residueCharacter L ζ k (x + y) = residueCharacter L ζ k x * residueCharacter L ζ k y

Bosonize.A01.residue_character_int_cast.text: lemma residue_character_int_cast (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k x : ℤ) : residueCharacter L ζ (k : Ch01.Lattice L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) = integerCharacter ζ k x

Bosonize.A01.residue_character_neg.text: lemma residue_character_neg (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k x : Ch01.Lattice L) : residueCharacter L ζ (-k) x = (residueCharacter L ζ k x)⁻¹

Bosonize.A01.residue_character_sub.text: lemma residue_character_sub (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k p x : Ch01.Lattice L) : residueCharacter L ζ (k - p) x = residueCharacter L ζ k x * (residueCharacter L ζ p x)⁻¹

Bosonize.A01.residue_character_zero.text: lemma residue_character_zero (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : residueCharacter L ζ 0 x = 1

Bosonize.A01.root_ne_zero.text: lemma root_ne_zero (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) : ζ ≠ 0

Bosonize.A01.root_pow_size.text: lemma root_pow_size (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) : ζ ^ L = 1

Bosonize.A01.singleton_character.text: lemma singleton_character (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ 1) (k : Ch01.Band 1) (x : Ch01.Lattice 1) : bandCharacter 1 ζ k x = 1

Bosonize.A01.sum_band_eq_sum_lattice.text: lemma sum_band_eq_sum_lattice (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (f : Ch01.Lattice L → K) : (∑ k : Ch01.Band L, f (Ch01.bandProjection L k)) = ∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, f x

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch01.inBandPredicate
commands.text: def inBandPredicate (L : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : Prop := -(L : ℤ) < 2 * k ∧ 2 * k ≤ (L : ℤ)

commands.label: instance (L : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : Decidable (inBandPredi
commands.text:
instance (L : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : Decidable (inBandPredicate L k) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch01.Band
commands.text: abbrev Band (L : ℕ) := {k : ℤ // inBandPredicate L k}

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch01.bandFinset
commands.text:
def bandFinset (L : ℕ) : Finset ℤ :=
  (Finset.Icc (-(L : ℤ)) (L : ℤ)).filter (inBandPredicate L)

commands.label: instance (L : ℕ) : Fintype (Band L) :=
commands.text:
instance (L : ℕ) : Fintype (Band L) :=
  Fintype.ofFinset (bandFinset L) (by
    intro k
    change k ∈ bandFinset L ↔ inBandPredicate L k
    simp only [bandFinset, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
    unfold inBandPredicate
    omega)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch01.quotientMap
commands.text: def quotientMap (L : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : Lattice L := (k : ZMod L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch01.bandProjection
commands.text: def bandProjection (L : ℕ) (k : Band L) : Lattice L := quotientMap L k.val

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch01.representative
commands.text:
def representative (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (x : Lattice L) : Band L := by
  letI : NeZero L := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hL⟩
  have hx := ZMod.val_lt x
  exact if h : 2 * (x.val : ℤ) ≤ (L : ℤ) then
    ⟨(x.val : ℤ), by unfold inBandPredicate; omega⟩
  else
    ⟨(x.val : ℤ) - (L : ℤ), by unfold inBandPredicate; omega⟩

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch01.bandAdd
commands.text:
def bandAdd (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (k p : Band L) : Band L :=
  representative L hL (bandProjection L k + bandProjection L p)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch01.bandNeg
commands.text:
def bandNeg (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (k : Band L) : Band L :=
  representative L hL (-bandProjection L k)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch01.zeroMomentum
commands.text:
def zeroMomentum (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : Band L :=
  ⟨0, by unfold inBandPredicate; omega⟩

Bosonize.Ch01.band_add_assoc.text: lemma band_add_assoc (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (k p q : Band L) : bandAdd L hL (bandAdd L hL k p) q = bandAdd L hL k (bandAdd L hL p q)

Bosonize.Ch01.band_add_comm.text: lemma band_add_comm (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (k p : Band L) : bandAdd L hL k p = bandAdd L hL p k

Bosonize.Ch01.band_add_projection.text: lemma band_add_projection (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (k p : Band L) : bandProjection L (bandAdd L hL k p) = bandProjection L k + bandProjection L p

Bosonize.Ch01.band_add_wrap.text: lemma band_add_wrap (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (k p : Band L) : ∃! w : ℤ, (-1 ≤ w ∧ w ≤ 1) ∧ (bandAdd L hL k p).val = k.val + p.val - w * (L : ℤ)

Bosonize.Ch01.band_neg_add_cancel.text: lemma band_neg_add_cancel (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (k : Band L) : bandAdd L hL (bandNeg L hL k) k = zeroMomentum L hL

Bosonize.Ch01.band_neg_of_ne_nyquist.text: lemma band_neg_of_ne_nyquist (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hEven : Even L) (k : Band L) (hk : k.val ≠ ((L / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) : (bandNeg L hL k).val = -k.val

Bosonize.Ch01.band_neg_projection.text: lemma band_neg_projection (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (k : Band L) : bandProjection L (bandNeg L hL k) = -bandProjection L k

Bosonize.Ch01.band_projection_bijective.text: lemma band_projection_bijective (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : Function.Bijective (bandProjection L)

Bosonize.Ch01.band_zero_add.text: lemma band_zero_add (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (k : Band L) : bandAdd L hL (zeroMomentum L hL) k = k

Bosonize.Ch01.card_band.text: lemma card_band (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : Fintype.card (Band L) = L

Bosonize.Ch01.card_band_finset.text: lemma card_band_finset (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : (bandFinset L).card = L

Bosonize.Ch01.even_band_bounds.text: lemma even_band_bounds (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hEven : Even L) (k : ℤ) : inBandPredicate L k ↔ -((L / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ ((L / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)

Bosonize.Ch01.mem_band_finset.text: lemma mem_band_finset (L : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : k ∈ bandFinset L ↔ inBandPredicate L k

Bosonize.Ch01.nyquist_neg.text: lemma nyquist_neg (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hEven : Even L) (k : Band L) (hk : k.val = ((L / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) : bandNeg L hL k = k

Bosonize.Ch01.odd_band_neg.text: lemma odd_band_neg (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hOdd : Odd L) (k : Band L) : (bandNeg L hL k).val = -k.val

Bosonize.Ch01.projection_representative.text: lemma projection_representative (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (x : Lattice L) : bandProjection L (representative L hL x) = x

Bosonize.Ch01.representative_projection.text: lemma representative_projection (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (k : Band L) : representative L hL (bandProjection L k) = k

Bosonize.Ch01.representative_unique.text: lemma representative_unique (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (x : Lattice L) (k : Band L) (hk : bandProjection L k = x) : k = representative L hL x

Bosonize.Ch01.zero_mem_band.text: lemma zero_mem_band (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : inBandPredicate L 0

commands.label: variable {S R : Type*} [AddCommGroup S] [One S] [
commands.text: variable {S R : Type*} [AddCommGroup S] [One S] [CommRing R]

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch02.shift
commands.text:
def shift : Module.End R (S → R) where
  toFun f x := f (x + 1)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch02.inverseShift
commands.text:
def inverseShift : Module.End R (S → R) where
  toFun f x := f (x - 1)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch02.identity
commands.text: def identity : Module.End R (S → R) := LinearMap.id

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch02.forwardDiff
commands.text: def forwardDiff : Module.End R (S → R) := shift - identity

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch02.backwardDiff
commands.text: def backwardDiff : Module.End R (S → R) := identity - inverseShift

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch02.laplacian
commands.text: def laplacian : Module.End R (S → R) := forwardDiff.comp backwardDiff

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch02.fallingFactorial
commands.text:
noncomputable def fallingFactorial (n : ℕ) : Polynomial R :=
  ∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (k : R))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch02.umbralMap
commands.text:
noncomputable def umbralMap : Module.End R (Polynomial R) :=
  Polynomial.lsum fun n ↦ LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R (Polynomial R) (fallingFactorial n)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch02.polyShift
commands.text:
noncomputable def polyShift : Module.End R (Polynomial R) :=
  (Polynomial.aeval (Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial R)).toLinearMap

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch02.polyForwardDiff
commands.text:
noncomputable def polyForwardDiff : Module.End R (Polynomial R) :=
  polyShift - LinearMap.id

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch02.posMultiplier
commands.text:
def posMultiplier : Module.End R (ℤ → R) where
  toFun f x := (x : R) * f (x - 1)
  map_add' f g := by
    funext x
    exact mul_add (x : R) (f (x - 1)) (g (x - 1))
  map_smul' r f := by
    funext x
    exact mul_left_comm (x : R) r (f (x - 1))

Bosonize.Ch02.backward_diff_apply.text: lemma backward_diff_apply (f : S → R) (x : S) : backwardDiff f x = f x - f (x - 1)

Bosonize.Ch02.discrete_leibniz_left.text: lemma discrete_leibniz_left (f g : S → R) : forwardDiff (f * g) = forwardDiff f * g + shift f * forwardDiff g

Bosonize.Ch02.discrete_leibniz_right.text: lemma discrete_leibniz_right (f g : S → R) : forwardDiff (f * g) = f * forwardDiff g + forwardDiff f * shift g

Bosonize.Ch02.falling_factorial_monic.text: lemma falling_factorial_monic [Nontrivial R] (n : ℕ) : (fallingFactorial (R := R) n).Monic

Bosonize.Ch02.falling_factorial_succ.text: lemma falling_factorial_succ (n : ℕ) : fallingFactorial (R := R) (n + 1) = fallingFactorial n * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (n : R))

Bosonize.Ch02.finite_dimensional_no_go.text: lemma finite_dimensional_no_go {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) : A * B - B * A ≠ 1

Bosonize.Ch02.forward_diff_apply.text: lemma forward_diff_apply (f : S → R) (x : S) : forwardDiff f x = f (x + 1) - f x

Bosonize.Ch02.forward_diff_const.text: lemma forward_diff_const (r : R) : forwardDiff (S := S) (fun _ ↦ r) = 0

Bosonize.Ch02.forward_diff_int_cast.text: lemma forward_diff_int_cast : forwardDiff (fun x : ℤ ↦ (x : R)) = fun _ ↦ (1 : R)

Bosonize.Ch02.forward_diff_nonzero.text: lemma forward_diff_nonzero [Nontrivial R] : forwardDiff (S := ℤ) (R := R) ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch02.heisenberg_pair.text: lemma heisenberg_pair (f : ℤ → R) : forwardDiff (posMultiplier f) - posMultiplier (forwardDiff f) = f

Bosonize.Ch02.heisenberg_pair_operator.text: lemma heisenberg_pair_operator : (forwardDiff (S := ℤ) (R := R)).comp posMultiplier - posMultiplier.comp forwardDiff = identity

Bosonize.Ch02.identity_apply.text: omit [AddCommGroup S] [One S] in lemma identity_apply (f : S → R) (x : S) : identity f x = f x

Bosonize.Ch02.inverse_shift_apply.text: lemma inverse_shift_apply (f : S → R) (x : S) : inverseShift f x = f (x - 1)

Bosonize.Ch02.inverse_shift_shift.text: lemma inverse_shift_shift : (inverseShift (S := S) (R := R)).comp shift = identity

Bosonize.Ch02.laplacian_apply.text: lemma laplacian_apply (f : S → R) (x : S) : laplacian f x = f (x + 1) + f (x - 1) - 2 * f x

Bosonize.Ch02.laplacian_operator.text: lemma laplacian_operator : laplacian (S := S) (R := R) = shift + inverseShift - (2 : ℕ) • identity

Bosonize.Ch02.newton_expansion.text: lemma newton_expansion (n : ℕ) : (shift (S := S) (R := R)) ^ n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n k) • (forwardDiff ^ k)

Bosonize.Ch02.newton_expansion_apply.text: lemma newton_expansion_apply (n : ℕ) (f : S → R) : (shift ^ n) f = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n k) • ((forwardDiff ^ k) f)

Bosonize.Ch02.poly_forward_diff_apply.text: lemma poly_forward_diff_apply (p : Polynomial R) : polyForwardDiff p = p.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) - p

Bosonize.Ch02.poly_shift_apply.text: lemma poly_shift_apply (p : Polynomial R) : polyShift p = p.comp (Polynomial.X + 1)

Bosonize.Ch02.pos_multiplier_apply.text: lemma pos_multiplier_apply (f : ℤ → R) (x : ℤ) : posMultiplier f x = (x : R) * f (x - 1)

Bosonize.Ch02.shift_apply.text: lemma shift_apply (f : S → R) (x : S) : shift f x = f (x + 1)

Bosonize.Ch02.shift_inverse.text: lemma shift_inverse : (shift (S := S) (R := R)).comp inverseShift = identity

Bosonize.Ch02.sum_by_parts.text: lemma sum_by_parts (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (f g : Ch01.Lattice L → R) : ∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, f x * forwardDiff g x = - ∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, backwardDiff f x * g x

Bosonize.Ch02.umbral_commutation.text: lemma umbral_commutation : (umbralMap (R := R)).comp Polynomial.derivative = polyForwardDiff.comp umbralMap

Bosonize.Ch02.umbral_map_X_pow.text: lemma umbral_map_X_pow (n : ℕ) : umbralMap (Polynomial.X ^ n : Polynomial R) = fallingFactorial n

Bosonize.Ch02.umbral_map_apply.text: lemma umbral_map_apply (p : Polynomial R) : umbralMap p = ∑ n ∈ p.support, p.coeff n • fallingFactorial n

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.analysis
commands.text:
noncomputable def analysis (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) :
    (Ch01.Lattice L → K) →ₗ[K] (Ch01.Band L → K) where
  toFun f k := ∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, f x * A01.integerCharacter ζ (-k.val) (x.val : ℤ)
  map_add' f g := by
    funext k
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c f := by
    funext k
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.synthesis
commands.text:
noncomputable def synthesis (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) :
    (Ch01.Band L → K) →ₗ[K] (Ch01.Lattice L → K) where
  toFun g x := ∑ k : Ch01.Band L, g k * A01.bandCharacter L ζ k x
  map_add' f g := by
    funext x
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c f := by
    funext x
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.inverseAnalysis
commands.text:
noncomputable def inverseAnalysis (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) :
    (Ch01.Band L → K) →ₗ[K] (Ch01.Lattice L → K) := (L : K)⁻¹ • synthesis L ζ

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch03.PositionSpace
commands.text: abbrev PositionSpace (L : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℂ (Ch01.Lattice L)

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch03.MomentumSpace
commands.text: abbrev MomentumSpace (L : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℂ (Ch01.Band L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.positionFunctions
commands.text:
noncomputable def positionFunctions (L : ℕ) : PositionSpace L ≃ₗ[ℂ] (Ch01.Lattice L → ℂ) :=
  WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (Ch01.Lattice L → ℂ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.momentumFunctions
commands.text:
noncomputable def momentumFunctions (L : ℕ) : MomentumSpace L ≃ₗ[ℂ] (Ch01.Band L → ℂ) :=
  WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (Ch01.Band L → ℂ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.analysisEuclidean
commands.text:
noncomputable def analysisEuclidean (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : PositionSpace L →ₗ[ℂ] MomentumSpace L :=
  (momentumFunctions L).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    ((analysis L (A01.canonicalRoot L)).comp (positionFunctions L).toLinearMap)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.synthesisEuclidean
commands.text:
noncomputable def synthesisEuclidean (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : MomentumSpace L →ₗ[ℂ] PositionSpace L :=
  (positionFunctions L).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    ((synthesis L (A01.canonicalRoot L)).comp (momentumFunctions L).toLinearMap)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.unitaryFourier
commands.text:
noncomputable def unitaryFourier (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : PositionSpace L →ₗ[ℂ] MomentumSpace L :=
  (A01.normalization L : ℂ) • analysisEuclidean L

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.inverseUnitaryFourier
commands.text:
noncomputable def inverseUnitaryFourier (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : MomentumSpace L →ₗ[ℂ] PositionSpace L :=
  (A01.normalization L : ℂ) • synthesisEuclidean L

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.transportPositionOperator
commands.text:
noncomputable def transportPositionOperator (L : ℕ)
    (A : Module.End ℂ (Ch01.Lattice L → ℂ)) : Module.End ℂ (PositionSpace L) :=
  (positionFunctions L).symm.toLinearMap.comp (A.comp (positionFunctions L).toLinearMap)

Bosonize.Ch03.analysisEuclidean_adjoint.text: lemma analysisEuclidean_adjoint (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (analysisEuclidean L).adjoint = synthesisEuclidean L

Bosonize.Ch03.analysisEuclidean_synthesi.text: lemma analysisEuclidean_synthesisEuclidean (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (analysisEuclidean L).comp (synthesisEuclidean L) = (L : ℂ) • LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_apply.text: lemma analysis_apply (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (f : Ch01.Lattice L → K) (k : Ch01.Band L) : analysis L ζ f k = ∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, f x * A01.integerCharacter ζ (-k.val) (x.val : ℤ)

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_backward_diff.text: lemma analysis_backward_diff (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (f : Ch01.Lattice L → K) (k : Ch01.Band L) : analysis L ζ (Ch02.backwardDiff f) k = (1 - ζ ^ (-k.val)) * analysis L ζ f k

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_bijective.text: lemma analysis_bijective (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (hLK : (L : K) ≠ 0) : Function.Bijective (analysis L ζ)

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_delta_zero.text: lemma analysis_delta_zero (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) : analysis L ζ (Pi.single (0 : Ch01.Lattice L) 1) = fun _ ↦ 1

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_eq_dft.text: lemma analysis_eq_dft (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (f : Ch01.Lattice L → ℂ) (k : Ch01.Band L) : analysis L (A01.canonicalRoot L) f k = ZMod.dft f (Ch01.bandProjection L k)

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_forward_diff.text: lemma analysis_forward_diff (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (f : Ch01.Lattice L → K) (k : Ch01.Band L) : analysis L ζ (Ch02.forwardDiff f) k = (ζ ^ k.val - 1) * analysis L ζ f k

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_laplacian.text: lemma analysis_laplacian (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (f : Ch01.Lattice L → K) (k : Ch01.Band L) : analysis L ζ (Ch02.laplacian f) k = (ζ ^ k.val + ζ ^ (-k.val) - 2) * analysis L ζ f k

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_synthesis.text: lemma analysis_synthesis (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) : (analysis L ζ).comp (synthesis L ζ) = (L : K) • LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.backward_diff_character.text: lemma backward_diff_character (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch02.backwardDiff (A01.bandCharacter L ζ k) = (1 - ζ ^ (-k.val)) • A01.bandCharacter L ζ k

Bosonize.Ch03.canonical_laplacian_disper.text: lemma canonical_laplacian_dispersion (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (k : ℤ) : A01.canonicalRoot L ^ k + A01.canonicalRoot L ^ (-k) - 2 = ((-4 * Real.sin (Real.pi * (k : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)

Bosonize.Ch03.forward_diff_character.text: lemma forward_diff_character (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch02.forwardDiff (A01.bandCharacter L ζ k) = (ζ ^ k.val - 1) • A01.bandCharacter L ζ k

Bosonize.Ch03.inverse_analysis_eq_inv_df.text: lemma inverse_analysis_eq_inv_dft (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (g : Ch01.Band L → ℂ) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : inverseAnalysis L (A01.canonicalRoot L) g x = (ZMod.dft.symm (fun r ↦ g ((A01.bandEquiv L).symm r))) x

Bosonize.Ch03.inverse_analysis_left.text: lemma inverse_analysis_left (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (hLK : (L : K) ≠ 0) : (inverseAnalysis L ζ).comp (analysis L ζ) = LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.inverse_analysis_right.text: lemma inverse_analysis_right (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (hLK : (L : K) ≠ 0) : (analysis L ζ).comp (inverseAnalysis L ζ) = LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.inverse_shift_character.text: lemma inverse_shift_character (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch02.inverseShift (A01.bandCharacter L ζ k) = (ζ ^ (-k.val)) • A01.bandCharacter L ζ k

Bosonize.Ch03.laplacian_character.text: lemma laplacian_character (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch02.laplacian (A01.bandCharacter L ζ k) = (ζ ^ k.val + ζ ^ (-k.val) - 2) • A01.bandCharacter L ζ k

Bosonize.Ch03.laplacian_eigenvalue_facto.text: lemma laplacian_eigenvalue_factor (ζ : K) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (k : ℤ) : (ζ ^ k - 1) * (1 - ζ ^ (-k)) = ζ ^ k + ζ ^ (-k) - 2

Bosonize.Ch03.shift_character.text: lemma shift_character (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch02.shift (A01.bandCharacter L ζ k) = (ζ ^ k.val) • A01.bandCharacter L ζ k

Bosonize.Ch03.singleton_analysis.text: lemma singleton_analysis (f : Ch01.Lattice 1 → ℂ) (k : Ch01.Band 1) : analysis 1 (A01.canonicalRoot 1) f k = f 0

Bosonize.Ch03.synthesisEuclidean_analysi.text: lemma synthesisEuclidean_analysisEuclidean (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (synthesisEuclidean L).comp (analysisEuclidean L) = (L : ℂ) • LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.synthesis_analysis.text: lemma synthesis_analysis (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) : (synthesis L ζ).comp (analysis L ζ) = (L : K) • LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.synthesis_apply.text: lemma synthesis_apply (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (g : Ch01.Band L → K) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : synthesis L ζ g x = ∑ k : Ch01.Band L, g k * A01.bandCharacter L ζ k x

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_adjoint.text: lemma unitary_adjoint (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (unitaryFourier L).adjoint = inverseUnitaryFourier L

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_inner.text: lemma unitary_inner (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (f g : PositionSpace L) : inner ℂ (unitaryFourier L f) (unitaryFourier L g) = inner ℂ f g

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_inverse_left.text: lemma unitary_inverse_left (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (inverseUnitaryFourier L).comp (unitaryFourier L) = LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_inverse_right.text: lemma unitary_inverse_right (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (unitaryFourier L).comp (inverseUnitaryFourier L) = LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_isometry.text: lemma unitary_isometry (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : Isometry (unitaryFourier L)

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_laplacian.text: lemma unitary_laplacian (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (f : PositionSpace L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : momentumFunctions L (unitaryFourier L (transportPositionOperator L Ch02.laplacian f)) k = (A01.canonicalRoot L ^ k.val + A01.canonicalRoot L ^ (-k.val) - 2) * momentumFunctions L (unitaryFourier L f) k

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_surjective.text: lemma unitary_surjective (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : Function.Surjective (unitaryFourier L)
